mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, type, name, calories, record_date as recordDate, create_time as createTime, meal_plan_id as mealPlanId from calorie_record where user_id = #{userId} order by record_date desc, create_time desc

select id, user_id as userId, type, name, calories, record_date as recordDate, create_time as createTime, meal_plan_id as mealPlanId from calorie_record where user_id = #{userId} and record_date = #{recordDate} order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into calorie_record(user_id, type, name, calories, record_date, meal_plan_id) values(#{userId}, #{type}, #{name}, #{calories}, #{recordDate}, #{mealPlanId})
mapper.select: select type, sum(calories) as total from calorie_record where user_id = #{userId} and record_date = #{recordDate} group by type
